items.title: An exact edge-counting identity for the Gallai-Edmonds parameters of a graph
items.author: Sahar Diskin, Anna Geisler
items.work: \vspace{-1.5cm}Perfect Matching in Product Graphs\\ and in their Random Subgraphs
items.difficulty_reason: The counted statement is the exact edge-counting identity for the Gallai-Edmonds parameters (author lemma at source lines 1099-1103, whose statement is the author's own display eq:ge-exact). The proof (source lines 1105-1127) is a two-sided degree summation: it sums degrees over the D part to relate the parameter h to the internal, inter-component and boundary edges (proof lines 1106-1113), sums degrees over A (proof lines 1114-1117), and then substitutes the two structural relations of the Gallai-Edmonds decomposition, using the oddness of the component sizes to merge the two sums into one (proof lines 1118-1127). The identity is what makes the later probabilistic estimates on the decomposition quantitative, and the proof has to keep track of which edges are counted twice. H2.
